about: Distractor review for the Spot the Concept seed bank. For each problem, every distractor was tried as a first move; anything that actually leads to a solution was moved to also_valid. 'borderline' marks a judgment call worth a second look. Answers are checked separately by scripts/spot/verify_answers.py. Reviewed by Claude in the authoring session, not an independent reviewer.

distractors.polynomial-remainder: fails: evaluating P gives values, never root sums
distractors.quadratics: fails: no rational root, so no reduction to a quadratic
distractors.systems-of-equations: fails: would require the three irrational roots

excluded.symmetric-sums: the follow-up step after Vieta, not an alternative; kept out of the choices

distractors.quadratics: fails: floor term is not constant until n is fixed
distractors.algebraic-manipulation: fails: no rearrangement removes the floor

distractors.sequences: fails: factors are not arithmetic or geometric
distractors.polynomial-remainder: fails: factor theorem helps factor k^3-1 but does not collapse the product
distractors.vieta: fails: no fixed polynomial's roots are involved
distractors.logarithms: fails: turns the product into a sum with no new structure

alg-0003.borderline: algebraic-manipulation would arguably also be a correct label (the factoring), so it was left out of the choices entirely

distractors.pythagorean-theorem: fails: no right angle, radius unknown
distractors.law-of-cosines: fails: no known angle at E

moved_to_also_valid.similar-triangles: AEC ~ DEB gives the same equation

excluded.circle-angles: inscribed angles are the first step of the similarity route, so it is not a clean distractor

distractors.pythagorean-theorem: fails as a first move: gives the cut triangle's sides but not the tetrahedron's height to it
distractors.heron-formula: fails: area of the slanted face without its height gives no volume
distractors.similar-triangles: fails: no scaled copies in the figure

distractors.power-of-a-point: fails: P is on the circle, power zero, no chord pair through P
distractors.pythagorean-theorem: fails: no right angle without adding a diameter
distractors.angle-bisector-theorem: fails on its own: PA bisects angle BPC but where it meets BC adds an unknown
distractors.similar-triangles: borderline: Ptolemy has a similarity proof, but it needs a constructed point; nothing in the given figure is similar

moved_to_also_valid.law-of-cosines: angle APB = angle APC = 60 degrees gives a quadratic with roots 5 and 8; works but needs the extra case check

distractors.pigeonhole: fails: 5 dice, 6 faces, so no repeat is guaranteed (the intended trap)
distractors.linearity-of-expectation: fails: gives an expected number of matches, not a probability

moved_to_also_valid.casework: six repetition patterns can be counted directly

excluded.inclusion-exclusion: over the 10 pairs it technically works, so it was kept out rather than used as a distractor

distractors.linearity-of-expectation: fails: the stopping time does not split into usable indicators

distractors.overcounting: fails: rotations are counted as different, so dividing is wrong (the intended trap)
distractors.stars-and-bars: fails: positions are distinct with adjacency rules

comb-0003.borderline: casework (on how many colors appear, or on the opposite pairs) also works, so it was left out of the choices

distractors.modular-arithmetic: fails: mod 9 shows both numbers agree, not which number
distractors.diophantine-factoring: fails: equations are linear once written in digits

excluded.systems-of-equations: the follow-up step, not an alternative

distractors.modular-arithmetic: fails: remainders do not count divisors

excluded.legendre-formula: used to factor 12!, a sub-step rather than an alternative

distractors.modular-arithmetic: fails: can rule pairs out, cannot count them
distractors.pell-equations: fails: the equation is a product after clearing denominators, not x^2 - dy^2 = 1 (surface trap: integer pairs)

excluded.divisor-counting: the follow-up step (count divisors of 144), not an alternative

moved_to_also_valid.gcd-lcm: parametrizing x = da, y = db works but is slow
